title: Vocabulary Expedition
summary: Large illustrated scenes where children find objects from clues, match words to pictures and use new words in short sentences.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop works at 390x844 (verified live): stations show as a vertical trail list (no clipping or overlap), the 1200x800 scene plate keeps its aspect, hotspots hold a 44px hit-rect minimum, and label match runs through tap-chip-then-tap-object pick-and-place. Pointer drag precision is lower than tablet — pick-and-place is the primary path on phones.

cover.alt: Staged mid-lesson moment on the Living Room gouache plate during the word-label task: three word labels pinned as museum annotations (picture on the framed art, bookshelf on the shelf, sofa on the couch), berry check pins marking the four clue-found words, and the label dock below reading Word labels 3/4 pinned with the last chip rug in the tray

desktop.alt: Honest default landing: the expedition map — a gouache landscape with a dotted footpath connecting six illustrated stations (The Living Room, The Kitchen, The Classroom, The Market, The Farm, The Park), Pip the sparrow marking the start station

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view of the scene screen: task-rail stamps (Look around, Clue hunt, Word labels, Sentences), the Living Room gouache plate, and a caption plate for sofa — sofa /ˈsəʊ.fə/ · ghế sofa — over the activity dock

mobile.alt: Honest mobile landing: the six stations as a vertical trail list — round badge, English name and Vietnamese name per row, Pip the sparrow beside the start station, a dotted berry route running down the left edge
